description: Append-only writer for the runtime knowledge base under .ai/knowledge/. Used by the learner agent (and any agent surfacing a durable insight) so future sessions inherit lessons. Never edits .ai/instruct.md — those edits go through the curator after a learner proposal.
checklist: 1. Validate the payload contains: kind (pattern|surprise|rejected_approach|gap|risk), title (<= 80 chars), summary (1-3 sentences), evidence (paths or commit refs), scope_path, proposed_instruction_change (optional — text the learner would like the curator to weave into .ai/instruct.md)
2. Compute the target file: .ai/knowledge/<kind>s.md (e.g. patterns.md, surprises.md). Create with a header if absent.

3. Append a dated, structured block (never overwrite or reorder existing entries): '## <ISO date> — <title>
**Scope**: <scope_path>
**Evidence**: <evidence>

<summary>

_Proposed instruction change_: <text or `none`>'
4. If proposed_instruction_change is non-empty, also call append-todo to file a follow-up for the curator (severity: minor, tag: curator-handoff) so the proposal is not lost
5. Call log-action to record the capture (kind, title, target file)
6. Return { knowledge_file, line_anchor, todo_filed (bool) } to the caller
